context: governed catalog consulted: no match; derived scope-specific download cohorts and Kilter duration
methods: Observed ordered completion on distinct_id + OS + scopeKey. The mobile taxonomy lacks $device_id; this is an identity proxy. The first subsequent Download Started or Download Completed determines the match, so one completion credits at most one start. A missing completion is an unobserved outcome, including deliberate removal, delayed reconnect, telemetry loss, restart or true failure.

Mature starts Oct 17–Nov 13 UTC inclusive, follow-up through Nov 20, 7 days per start. Recent starts Nov 14–19 UTC, 24 hours per start. Date cutoffs in UTC. Numeric app version is a native version, not an OTA update ID.

Quantiles of matched timestamps measure elapsed time including background waits. Separate Kilter snapshot duration analysis uses measured scope lifetime on recorded Completed events incl. missing or false bootstrapHealed and excludes true.
Native scope requires the production store app namespace com.boardsesh.app, excluding browser events on mobile operating systems.

queries.name: mature_fleet
queries.query:
WITH ordered_events AS (
 SELECT person_id AS climber, distinct_id AS identity, properties.scopeKey AS scope_key, properties.$os AS platform,
   properties.$app_version AS app_version, properties.trigger AS trigger, timestamp AS event_time, event AS event_name,
   leadInFrame(event, 1, '') OVER stream AS following_name,
   leadInFrame(timestamp, 1, timestamp) OVER stream AS following_time
 FROM events
 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-17 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-21 00:00:00','UTC')
   AND event IN ('Offline Board Download Started','Offline Board Download Completed')
   AND properties.environment = 'production' AND properties.$os IN ('iOS','iPadOS','Android')
   AND {filters} AND notEmpty(properties.scopeKey)
 WINDOW stream AS (PARTITION BY distinct_id, properties.$os, properties.scopeKey ORDER BY timestamp, uuid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, following_name = 'Offline Board Download Completed' AND dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 604800 AS completed7,
   dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) AS seconds_to_next
 FROM ordered_events
 WHERE event_name='Offline Board Download Started' AND event_time < toDateTime('2026-11-14 00:00:00','UTC')
) SELECT breakdown, count() AS starts, countIf(completed7) AS completed, uniqExact(climber) AS people, uniqExactIf(climber,completed7) AS people_with_completion, countIf(following_name='Offline Board Download Started') AS followed_by_restart, quantileExact(0.5)(if(completed7,seconds_to_next,NULL)) AS p50_seconds, quantileExact(0.9)(if(completed7,seconds_to_next,NULL)) AS p90_seconds FROM (SELECT *,arrayJoin(['all',concat('os/',platform),concat('board/',arrayElement(splitByChar(':',coalesce(scope_key,'')),1)),concat('app/',app_version),concat('switch/',if(trigger IN ('adopt-auto','auto-download-all','download-all'),'all-switch-related','other')),concat('auto/',if(trigger IN ('adopt-auto','auto-download-all'),'automatic','other'))]) AS breakdown FROM starts) GROUP BY breakdown ORDER BY breakdown

queries.name: mature_trigger_by_platform
queries.query:
WITH ordered_events AS (
 SELECT person_id AS climber, distinct_id AS identity, properties.scopeKey AS scope_key, properties.$os AS platform,
   properties.$app_version AS app_version, properties.trigger AS trigger, timestamp AS event_time, event AS event_name,
   leadInFrame(event, 1, '') OVER stream AS following_name,
   leadInFrame(timestamp, 1, timestamp) OVER stream AS following_time
 FROM events
 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-17 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-21 00:00:00','UTC')
   AND event IN ('Offline Board Download Started','Offline Board Download Completed')
   AND properties.environment = 'production' AND properties.$os IN ('iOS','iPadOS','Android')
   AND {filters} AND notEmpty(properties.scopeKey)
 WINDOW stream AS (PARTITION BY distinct_id, properties.$os, properties.scopeKey ORDER BY timestamp, uuid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, following_name = 'Offline Board Download Completed' AND dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 604800 AS completed7,
   dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) AS seconds_to_next
 FROM ordered_events
 WHERE event_name='Offline Board Download Started' AND event_time < toDateTime('2026-11-14 00:00:00','UTC')
) SELECT coalesce(trigger,'(missing)') AS start_trigger, platform, count() AS starts, countIf(completed7) AS completed,
 uniqExact(climber) AS people, uniqExactIf(climber,completed7) AS people_with_completion,
 countIf(following_name='Offline Board Download Started') AS followed_by_restart,
 quantileExact(0.5)(if(completed7,seconds_to_next,NULL)) AS median_seconds, quantileExact(0.9)(if(completed7,seconds_to_next,NULL)) AS p90_seconds
 FROM starts GROUP BY start_trigger,platform ORDER BY start_trigger,platform

queries.name: recent_24h
queries.query:
WITH ordered_events AS (
 SELECT person_id AS climber, distinct_id AS identity, properties.scopeKey AS scope_key, properties.$os AS platform,
   properties.$app_version AS app_version, properties.trigger AS trigger, timestamp AS event_time, event AS event_name,
   leadInFrame(event, 1, '') OVER stream AS following_name,

 FROM events
 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-17 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-21 00:00:00','UTC')
   AND event IN ('Offline Board Download Started','Offline Board Download Completed')
   AND properties.environment = 'production' AND properties.$os IN ('iOS','iPadOS','Android')
   AND {filters} AND notEmpty(properties.scopeKey)
 WINDOW stream AS (PARTITION BY distinct_id, properties.$os, properties.scopeKey ORDER BY timestamp, uuid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, following_name = 'Offline Board Download Completed' AND dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 604800 AS completed7,

 FROM ordered_events
 WHERE event_name='Offline Board Download Started' AND event_time >=toDateTime('2026-11-14 00:00:00','UTC') AND event_time < toDateTime('2026-11-20 00:00:00','UTC')
) SELECT app_version,platform,if(trigger IN ('download-all','auto-download-all','adopt-auto'),'switch-related','other') AS lane,count() AS starts,countIf(completed7 AND seconds_to_next<=86400) AS completed_24h,uniqExact(climber) AS people FROM starts GROUP BY app_version,platform,lane ORDER BY app_version,platform,lane

queries.name: kilter_snapshot_duration
queries.query: SELECT properties.$app_version AS app_version, properties.$os AS platform, count() AS completions, quantileExact(0.5)(toFloat(properties.durationMs)/1000) AS p50_s,quantileExact(0.9)(toFloat(properties.durationMs)/1000) AS p90_s, countIf(toFloat(properties.durationMs)>300000) AS over_5m FROM events WHERE timestamp>=toDateTime('2026-10-24 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp<toDateTime('2026-11-21 00:00:00','UTC') AND {filters} AND event='Offline Board Download Completed' AND startsWith(properties.scopeKey,'kilter:') AND properties.method='snapshot' AND coalesce(properties.bootstrapHealed,false)=false AND properties.durationMs IS NOT NULL GROUP BY app_version,platform ORDER BY app_version,platform

queries.name: all_observed_starts_per_person
queries.query:
WITH ordered_events AS (
 SELECT person_id AS climber, distinct_id AS identity, properties.scopeKey AS scope_key, properties.$os AS platform,
   properties.$app_version AS app_version, properties.trigger AS trigger, timestamp AS event_time, event AS event_name,
   leadInFrame(event, 1, '') OVER stream AS following_name,
   leadInFrame(timestamp, 1, timestamp) OVER stream AS following_time
 FROM events
 WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-17 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-21 00:00:00','UTC')
   AND event IN ('Offline Board Download Started','Offline Board Download Completed')
   AND properties.environment = 'production' AND properties.$os IN ('iOS','iPadOS','Android')
   AND {filters} AND notEmpty(properties.scopeKey)
 WINDOW stream AS (PARTITION BY distinct_id, properties.$os, properties.scopeKey ORDER BY timestamp, uuid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, following_name = 'Offline Board Download Completed' AND dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) BETWEEN 0 AND 604800 AS completed7,
   dateDiff('second',event_time,following_time) AS seconds_to_next
 FROM ordered_events
 WHERE event_name='Offline Board Download Started' AND event_time < toDateTime('2026-11-14 00:00:00','UTC')
) SELECT population,count() AS people,countIf(done>=1) AS at_least_one,countIf(done=started) AS all_observed_starts_done,sum(started) AS observed_starts,sum(done) AS observed_done FROM (SELECT population,climber,count() AS started,countIf(completed7) AS done FROM (SELECT *,arrayJoin(['all',if(trigger IN ('download-all','auto-download-all','adopt-auto'),'switch','non-switch'),if(trigger IN ('auto-download-all','adopt-auto'),'automatic','non-auto'),concat('version/',app_version)]) AS population FROM starts) GROUP BY population,climber) GROUP BY population ORDER BY population
